notes: The Royal Store's second painting (art/reference/store_2.png): the sections under the diamonds, stacked below store.json's in the same scroll. Each section is cut tight to its panel (x 155..928; the panels' own borders at y 95..362, 372..680, 690..1043, 1053..1264, 1275..1494, all 10 units apart) and laid on the view's ground.

Every plate and green button is painted empty; prices, counts and the Stipend's words are live. Painted words kept: the section titles, THE STEWARD / THE QUARTERMASTER, CLAIM TODAY, FREE, WATCH, RESTORE PURCHASES, TERMS, PRIVACY.

Daily deals: each slot keeps its painted picture (gift box, potions, charter, frame) while what is in it rotates, and each card is also cut on its own so a claimed slot can be dimmed. The fourth slot sells a Splendour cosmetic and shows that cosmetic's own picture: its card (store/deal_card_3) has the painted frame softened out, and the frame itself is kept as store/deal_frame_art for a frame cosmetic this build has no picture of.

icons/colour_chip and icons/colour_chip_face are the wardrobe painting's enamel chip (art/reference/wardrobe.png, x 367..459, y 1320..1424): the face is drawn over the chip in a name colour's own hue. The wardrobe will reuse them.

rewards/steward, quartermaster, largesse, patronage and stipend are the store's five products as reward lines (Art.reward_icon), for the Royal Delivery, the mail and the store's own tiles. The store paintings paint these things inside their scenes, where no key lifts them cleanly; the same subjects are painted large on the plain navy of the icon sheets (reward_icons.png, rewards_sheet.png), cut square round each object and drawn down to 120 -- every place draws a reward at 46..102.

crops.name: rewards/steward
crops.note: The Steward's reward line (key steward): the crowned key of rewards_sheet.png -- a steward keeps the house's keys, as the Comforts card paints him.

crops.name: rewards/quartermaster
crops.note: The Quartermaster's (key quartermaster): the laden supply cart of reward_icons.png -- more room for what a lord carries.

crops.name: rewards/largesse
crops.note: Royal Largesse's (key largesse): the royal chest thrown open, from rewards_sheet.png -- a treasure given to the whole kingdom.

crops.name: rewards/patronage
crops.note: Crown Patronage's (key patronage): the crown on its crimson cushion, the same crown the patron card paints, on rewards_sheet.png's plain ground.

crops.name: rewards/stipend
crops.note: The Royal Stipend's (key stipend): the royal writ, ribboned, with its quill, from reward_icons.png.

crops.name: store/tile_potions
crops.note: The Energy Potions the day's deals paint (slot 1), lifted off the card's navy for the offer popup's tiles: the store's own energy potions, at a size the popup's 120-unit picture box can draw without drawing up. The mail's small rewards/energy_potion is the same flask, drawn for a 46-unit window.
